messages:
pavan: Proposal: add a 'preview mode' for runtime defaults that generates a safety heatmap and a config-diff replay before apply.
sara: Love it. How do you imagine the heatmap?
marco: Heatmap = by-service + by-route buckets showing delta on p50/p95/error-rate/cost. color-coded bands + severity score.
tina: We should surface which tenants will be shadowed by existing overrides. nothing worse than silently being ignored.
pavan: Exactly. UX flow: select scope -> preview estimator (fast) -> run replay sample (opt-in) -> review heatmap + sample tenant list -> apply with staged ramp.
console-ux: UX note: make preview shareable (link) so PMs and SREs can review before commit. include an "explain delta" panel that lists likely causes.
sara: Technical: estimator should use recent 7d aggregated metrics to estimate deltas. replay should actually re-run request traces through the new flag logic but with throttled traffic.
marco: Implementation detail: we can implement replay by tagging a subset of ingested traces and replaying them to a replay service that runs with the new config. keep it read-only to avoid side-effects.
pavan: API sketch: POST /configs/preview { scope: "service", selector: { service: "payments" }, changes: { routing_policy: "prefer-fast-lane" }, replay_pct: 1, estimator_only: false } -> returns preview_id + estimator_summary + estimated_confidence.
deply-bot: preview queued: id preview-1792234567. Use `/preview status preview-1792234567` to poll.
tina: Safety rules: require both (a) estimator CI width < X and (b) replay sample shows no threshold breach to recommend apply. Otherwise show manual review required.
sara: What thresholds? propose defaults: error_delta_pct > 0.3, p95_ms + 40ms, cost_tokens +8% -> block. configurable per org.
pavan: Also add a 'safety leash' runtime: if applied, attach an auto-pause policy that will pause rollout when any metric crosses threshold for N consecutive minutes and revert to the reversal config.
marco: Reversal config should be auto-generated and stored with the rollout metadata. provide a one-click revert API.
console-ux: I'll design the preview canvas: top row summary, heatmap, top impacted tenants, trace thumbnails for sample traces, and an "apply" timeline with leash toggles.
sara: Tests: unit tests for estimator math, integration test for replay service using synthetic traces, and an e2e that goes through preview -> apply -> auto-pause.
tina: Auditing: every preview and apply must emit an immutable snapshot (config + metrics + preview outputs) to S3 and an audit event stream.
pavan: Ok next steps: marco spikes replay infra, sara implements estimator + thresholds, console-ux wires mocks, tina drafts audit schema. Sync Fri 2pm.
marco: Will post spike notes and a lightweight PoC by EOD Wed.
deploy-bot: preview-1792234567: replay started (est. 12m).
pavan: Thanks all. we'll iterate on the score formula after the spike. :thumbsup:
